type PcmSampleRepresentation =
    signed16-little-endian
    | signed24-little-endian
    | float32-little-endian

type PcmChannelLayout =
    mono
    | stereo-left-right

type PcmFrameHeader = {
    representation: PcmSampleRepresentation
    sample-rate-hz: U32 in 8000..=192000
    layout: PcmChannelLayout
    frame-count: U16 in 1..=2048
    clock-id: U64 in 1..=18446744073709551615
    start-frame: U64
    discontinuity: Boolean
    payload-bytes: U32 in 1..=65536
    where .payload-bytes == value/u32(.frame-count) * (.layout is mono ? 1 : 2) * (.representation is signed16-little-endian ? 2 : .representation is signed24-little-endian ? 3 : 4)
}


type UsbPcmCadence = {
    phase: U64 in 0..=999
    sample_rate: U64 in 8000..=48000
    channels: U64 in 1..=2
    sample_bytes: U64 in 1..=2
}
plot usb-pcm-packet-bytes (
    cadence: UsbPcmCadence >> bytes: U64
) = (((.phase + 1) * .sample_rate / 1000 - .phase * .sample_rate / 1000) * .channels * .sample_bytes)
plot usb-pcm-next-phase (
    cadence: UsbPcmCadence >> phase: U64
) = ((.phase + 1) % 1000)


# Class-neutral finite transaction data. Possession comes from the selected
# base, never from a setup word, endpoint number or packet contents.
type UsbControlRequest = {
    setup: U64
    output: sequence U8 <= 256
}

type UsbControlResult =
    completed {
        transferred: U16
        short: Boolean
        input: sequence U8 <= 256
    }
    | stalled
    | provider-lost
    | unsupported

# Cancellation is kernel control and terminal truth, not a successful result.

# Transport frames are explicit controller-domain deadlines. These Types contain
# no sample rate, channel, PCM format, endpoint selection or device authority.
type UsbIsochronousPacket = {
    frame: U64
    wire: Bytes <= 256B
}
type UsbIsochronousBatch = {
    packets: sequence UsbIsochronousPacket <= 72
}
type UsbIsochronousOutRequest =
    observe
    | batch UsbIsochronousBatch
    | drain

type UsbIsochronousClock = {
    current-microframe: U64
    scheduling-threshold: U64
    service-interval-microframes: U64
    maximum-packet-bytes: U64
    pending-packets: U64
    maximum-pending-packets: U64
    dma-resource-bytes: U64
}
type UsbIsochronousCompletion = {
    frame: U64
    requested: U64
    actual: U64
}
type UsbIsochronousCompletedBatch = {
    packets: sequence UsbIsochronousCompletion <= 72
}
type UsbIsochronousShort = {
    packet: UsbIsochronousCompletion
    completed: sequence UsbIsochronousCompletion <= 72
}
type UsbIsochronousMissed = {
    frame: U64
    completed: sequence UsbIsochronousCompletion <= 72
}
type UsbIsochronousStoppedBatch = {
    completed: sequence UsbIsochronousCompletion <= 72
}
type UsbIsochronousOutResult =
    snapshot UsbIsochronousClock
    | completed UsbIsochronousCompletedBatch
    | short UsbIsochronousShort
    | missed-service UsbIsochronousMissed
    | underrun UsbIsochronousStoppedBatch
    | provider-lost UsbIsochronousStoppedBatch
    | drained

# PcmFrameHeader is the existing semantics/audio owner, not a USB sample type.
# The finite profile only narrows the supported realization of that meaning.
type UsbAudioPcmPacket = {
    header: PcmFrameHeader
    cadence: UsbPcmCadence
    wire: Bytes <= 256B
    frame: U64 in 0..=2047
}
type UsbAudioPcmBatch = {
    packets: collection UsbAudioPcmPacket = 8
    transfer: UsbIsochronousOutRequest
}
type UsbAudioNegotiation = {
    configuration: UsbControlResult
    alternate: UsbControlResult
    set-rate: UsbControlResult
    get-rate: UsbControlResult
}
type UsbAudioPacketObservation = {
    packet: UsbAudioPcmPacket
    cadence-bytes: U64
}
type UsbAudioTerminal =
    completed
    | short
    | missed-service
    | underrun
    | provider-lost
    | drained
    | unsupported
# Cancellation remains the kernel's cancellation truth, never a fabricated
# successful ISO result. Native stop failure remains quarantined possession.
type UsbAudioBatchDecision =
    accepted UsbIsochronousOutRequest
    | unsupported

type UsbAudioPcmPair = {
    previous: UsbAudioPcmPacket
    next: UsbAudioPcmPacket
}
type UsbAudioSchedulingInput = {
    packet: UsbAudioPcmPacket
    clock: UsbIsochronousClock
}

# One lawful existing PCM header owns the whole ordered384-sample-frame block.
# These8 explicit payload projections collectively cover its1536 original bytes;
# the evidence checker compares their ordered concatenation with original PCM.
type UsbAudioPcmBlock = {
    header: PcmFrameHeader
    cadence: UsbPcmCadence
    packets: sequence UsbIsochronousPacket <= 8
}
type UsbAudioBlockSchedulingInput = {
    pcm: UsbAudioPcmBlock

}
# Only semantic continuity is retained between complete admitted blocks.
type UsbAudioBlockContinuity = {
    previous: PcmFrameHeader
